## 3. Cross-Discipline Coordination & Technical Achievements

### 3.1 Researcher Lead Agent (`TC-XMG-01` — 5 SP)
- Formulated SEBI & Clearing Corporation of India (CCIL/NSE Clearing) multi-asset cross-margining framework in `BRD-023`.
- Established statutory concession tiers:
  - Inter-Index Spread: 75% offset on matched deltas (NIFTY vs BANKNIFTY).
  - Index vs Constituent Stock Futures: 60%–80% offset (NIFTY vs RELIANCE, BANKNIFTY vs HDFCBANK).
  - Correlated Stock Pairs: 70% offset.
  - Inter-Commodity Spread: 70% offset on MCX Gold vs Silver.
  - Equity vs FX Macro Hedges: 50% offset on NIFTY vs USDINR.
- Outlined SEBI 5-tier statutory collateral haircut schedule (Cash 0%, G-Sec 2%, Liquid MF 10%, SGB 15%, Equities 20%) and 50:50 Cash-to-Collateral regulatory rule with 18% p.a. cash deficit penalty.

- Delivered `src/lib/crossMarginEngine.ts` and `src/types/crossMargin.ts`:

  - `calculatePortfolioHVaR()`: 252-day historical simulation VaR (99% 1-day), Expected Shortfall (CVaR), and Marginal Risk Contribution (MRC) Euler decomposition.

  - `runInstitutionalCrossMarginAudit()`: Comprehensive audit bridging cross-margining, collateral compliance, and VaR metrics into an institutional capital efficiency score (0–100).
